summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes a bundled obfuscated payload
details: The `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun v1.3.13) into a temporary directory, extracts and marks it executable, then invokes it against a bundled ~727KB heavily obfuscated file `math_init.js`. Both the loader (`setup.mjs`) and the executed payload (`math_init.js`) use obfuscator.io-style transformations (renamed identifiers like `_0x488df8`, `MmgoCP,etDiOOB,JqTtnbZ`, shuffled string-array with a rotator function, string-dictionary indirection) that hide the payload's real behavior and network destinations. The package is advertised as a Jest configuration preset for React Native, which has no need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or a large opaque binary payload at install time. Fetching a second JS runtime specifically to execute a bundled obfuscated blob on `npm install`, before any user action, is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern used to bypass Node-based scanners and run attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
